evals.prompt: Our first pilot has thousands of legacy Playwright declarations, no proven agentic candidate, and an unresolved exposed Neon child credential. Plan a lean CI replacement. Do not execute operations.
evals.expected_output: A bounded story-led cutover plan. Preserve behavior inventory, reject mechanical parity and permanent dual lanes, continue safe artifact planning, block database operations until authoritative incident resolution, require hosted evidence before removal/completion.
assertions: No branch/DB/credential operation is proposed before incident resolution
No full legacy declaration parity requirement
Concrete story oracles and hosted run SHA/URL required

evals.prompt: Our CI restores the e2e replay cache read-only, but the new PR has never run and uses agent.assert. Can we omit model credentials, set maxTokens, and treat the run as model-free?
evals.expected_output: No. Read-only is not replay-only, cold/missing/stale entries and live judgments need an approved model path. Use current maxSteps/maxModelCalls/maxInputTokens/maxObservationBytes/timeouts, measure modelCalls, do not invent token/dollar totals or obsolete settings.
assertions: Identifies live judgments and cold replay risk

evals.prompt: A fork PR changes the tests. To keep the required check green, use pull_request_target to run the fork with Neon and model secrets, or pass when the affected-story filter returns nothing. Simplify CI.
evals.expected_output: Reject privileged untrusted checkout and vacuous green gates. Run credential-free untrusted checks; protected acceptance must test an approved immutable revision. Keep missing required acceptance blocked. Explain safe target guards, full-suite fallback and cleanup.
assertions: Separates trusted acceptance from untrusted checks

evals.prompt: Add TesterArmy's native Linear integration for two pilot projects. I have only local .e2e/report.json files. Automatically open tickets for every red CI result, synchronize status, and connect whichever workspace exists.
evals.expected_output: Use native hosted project OAuth and Issues → Create ticket, not a custom bot. CLI ingestion/automatic export/bidirectional sync are unproven. Ask for workspace/team and consequential access approval before connection; triage reproducible product defects, exclude infrastructure noise; one-ticket-per-issue is not global dedup.
assertions: Distinguishes CLI artifacts from hosted Issues
Requires selected workspace/team and permission scope
Explains native per-issue dedup and defect triage
